subject: Didn't that character die...
author: SUFFUR
body:
Of brain Damage. LOL. 

I use to Play that game for real, with, Metal wheeled Roller Skates, Choppers (to pull us up the slant to get even more speed), a couple of Soft Balls (bigger than a base ball, but can still knock you out) and a slanted Round-a-bout (it was on a hill, around 30  degree slant), and use baseball gloves to catch, and spiked gloves (like cricket gloves) to punch someone in the face or balls, or use the said soft ball, and the goal was at the bottom of the hill (an old, spong-a-dunk contraption, sadly no buzzer). Start the ball on the drain at the top inside, do a loop or two, with various carnage, then try score a goal/point.

Oh, I miss my Child Hood.

 

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Paradise Islands!
author: ZombieTron
body:
WOW! Alex Ward has said there will be more than one Island with different types of Gameplay!!

😃

The DLC is becoming more than I thought it would be! I have started this Paradise Islands Poll with some Island ideas, but what kind of Island would you like to see? 

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Do we really need more offroad?
author: senocular
body: I worry about the offroad ideas - and similarly, the new Dust Storm car - because we already have current gen games which focus on that, i.e. Motostorm and MX vs ATV. The later of which even has a free-roaming world, not unlike burnout paradise, with dunes and dirt tracks, etc.  (And MX vs ATV even has a split screen multiplayer mode!)  So do we really need more of that?

subject: Offroad/Desert Island
author: ZombieTron
body:
erm... OK a Desert Island is a mound of sand with one palm tree on it, and maybe a beardy dude who has written SOS or HELP! in the sand, he might have a bottle in his hand with a message written in it, or he might be talking to a volley ball.... I wasn't expecting this option to get many votes, but it would be cool to have an island with sand dunes for the Dust Storm Dune Buggy to bounce around on!

An Offroad Island on  the other hand would have Dirt tracks, hills, streams, trees, and probably lots of mud flying around...

I think Paradise does lend itself to a destruction derby event... I really liked Destruction Derby, and Crash 'n Burn too... I will have to look into regetting those games I think! 😃

--- The Original and the Best ---
